scenarios.asserts: A cross-project error is reported against a workspace-relative document, a zero-based span, and the SHA-256 of the exact bytes compiled — so the editor can prove the diagnostic belongs to the snapshot it granted.

error.message: Es wurde kein Argument angegeben, das dem erforderlichen Parameter "options" von "ReportFormatter.Format(Report, FormatOptions)" entspricht.

scenarios.asserts: With FixtureCorrected=true the same snapshot builds, and every artifact is reported with its kind, size, and SHA-256 after a containment check.
Unsaved editor content reaches the build and is recorded in the input manifest as a dirty overlay, so a build can never compile something other than what the user is looking at.

Structured diagnostic identity is byte-identical across compiler UI languages while the message text is not. Anything that keyed off the message would be a locale-dependent bug that this repository's own German-language toolchain would hit first.
